title: Get Users: Gets information about the specified user

data.description: Supporting third-party developers building Twitch integrations from chatbots to game integrations.

means: Gets information about the specified user. To include the user's verified email address in the response, you must use a user access token that includes the user:read:email scope.

title: Get Users: the user in the access token
means: If you don't specify IDs or login names, the request returns information about the user in the access token if you specify a user access token.

title: Get Users: no id or login with an app access token
means: The id or login query parameter is required unless the request uses a user access token.

title: Get Users: no Authorization header
means: The Authorization header is required and must contain an app access token or user access token.

title: Get Users: an access token that is not valid
means: The access token is not valid.

title: Get Users: a Client-Id that is not the token's
means: The ID specified in the Client-Id header does not match the client ID specified in the access token.

title: Get Channel Information: Gets information about the TwitchDev channel
means: Gets information about the TwitchDev channel.

title: Get Channel Information: no broadcaster_id
means: The broadcaster_id query parameter is required.

title: Modify Channel Information: game, title, language and tags

input.title: there are helicopters in the game? REASON TO PLAY FORTNITE found

means: Updates a channel's properties. Successfully updated the channel's properties.

title: Modify Channel Information: Set CCLs for a Channel
means: Set CCLs for a Channel: a game_id, the content_classification_labels to add (is_enabled true) and remove (is_enabled false), and is_branded_content true. The page's body is written with typographic quotes and // comments, so it is not JSON as published.

title: Modify Channel Information: content classification labels added and removed
means: content_classification_labels: ID of the Content Classification Labels that must be added/removed from the channel. is_enabled: Boolean flag indicating whether the label should be enabled (true) or disabled for the channel. is_branded_content: Boolean flag indicating if the channel has branded content.

title: Modify Channel Information: an app access token
means: The Authorization header is required and must specify a user access token.

title: Modify Channel Information: a token without channel:manage:broadcast
means: The OAuth token must include the channel:manage:broadcast scope.

title: Modify Channel Information: no broadcaster_id
means: The broadcaster_id query parameter is required.

title: Modify Channel Information: another broadcaster's channel
means: The ID in broadcaster_id must match the user ID found in the OAuth token.

title: Modify Channel Information: nothing to update
means: The request must update at least one property.

title: Modify Channel Information: an empty title
means: The title field may not contain an empty string. (title: You may not set this field to an empty string.)

title: Modify Channel Information: a game ID Twitch does not know
means: The ID in game_id is not valid.

title: Modify Channel Information: the category unset
means: game_id: To unset this field, use 0 or an empty string.

title: Modify Channel Information: a delay from a broadcaster without partner status
means: To update the delay field, the broadcaster must have partner status. (delay: Only users with Partner status may set this field.)

title: Modify Channel Information: more than ten tags
means: The list in the tags field exceeds the maximum number of tags allowed. (tags: A channel may specify a maximum of 10 tags.)

title: Modify Channel Information: a tag longer than 25 characters
means: A tag in the tags field exceeds the maximum length allowed. (tags: Each tag is limited to a maximum of 25 characters.)

title: Get Streams: Gets information about the 20 most active streams

data.title: hablamos y le damos a Little Nightmares 1

means: Gets information about the 20 most active streams.

title: Get Streams: Gets streams for the specified logins

data.title: Jacob: Digital Den Laptops & Routers | NoPixel | !MAINGEAR !FCF

means: Gets streams for the specified logins. If the user is not live, the response doesn't include them.

title: Get Streams: a type that is not all or live
means: The value in the type query parameter is not valid. (type: Possible values are: all live)

title: Get Streams: a page size outside 1 to 100
means: first: The minimum page size is 1 item per page and the maximum is 100 items per page. The default is 20.

title: Get Stream Key
means: Gets the channel's stream key.

title: Get Stream Key: an app access token
means: The Authorization header is required and must contain a user access token.

title: Get Stream Key: a token without channel:read:stream_key
means: The user access token must include the channel:read:stream_key scope.

title: Get Stream Key: no broadcaster_id
means: The broadcaster_id field is required.

title: Get Stream Key: another broadcaster's key
means: The ID in broadcaster_id must match the user ID in the access token.

title: Send Chat Message
means: Sends a message to the broadcaster's chat room.

title: Send Chat Message: a reply
means: reply_parent_message_id: The ID of the chat message being replied to.

title: Send Chat Message: sent and pinned
means: pin: If true, the message will be sent and immediately pinned. Default: false. When pin is true, additionally requires the moderator:manage:chat_messages scope and the sender must be the broadcaster or a moderator. Messages pinned via this endpoint are always pinned for 20 minutes.

title: Send Chat Message: no broadcaster_id
means: The broadcaster_id query parameter is required.

title: Send Chat Message: no sender_id
means: The sender_id query parameter is required.

title: Send Chat Message: no message
means: The text query parameter is required.

title: Send Chat Message: a broadcaster_id Twitch does not know
means: The ID in the broadcaster_id query parameter is not valid.

title: Send Chat Message: a sender who is not the token's user
means: The ID in the user_id query parameter must match the user ID in the access token. (sender_id: This ID must match the user ID in the user access token.)

title: Send Chat Message: a token without user:write:chat
means: The user access token must include the user:write:chat scope.

title: Send Chat Message: for_source_only with a user access token
means: for_source_only: This parameter can only be set when utilizing an App Access Token. It cannot be specified when a User Access Token is used, and will instead result in an HTTP 400 error.

title: Send Chat Message: a reply that is pinned
means: The reply_parent_message_id parameter is not supported when pin is true. (pin: Cannot be combined with reply_parent_message_id or for_source_only.)

title: Send Chat Message: pinned without moderator:manage:chat_messages
means: Pinning requires the moderator:manage:chat_messages scope.

title: Send Chat Message: pinned by a sender who is not the broadcaster
means: The sender is not permitted to send chat messages to the broadcaster's chat room. (pin: the sender must be the broadcaster or a moderator.)

title: Send Chat Message: a reply to a message that is not there
means: The ID in the reply_parent_message_id query parameter is not valid.

title: Send Chat Message: a message of more than 500 characters
means: The message is too large. (message: The message is limited to a maximum of 500 characters.)

title: Search Categories: Gets the list of games and categories that contain fort in the name
means: Gets the list of games and categories that contain fort in the name.

title: Search Categories: no query
means: The query query parameter is required.
